Known as the Motown Mansion, the 10,500-square-foot residence at 918 W. Boston Blvd. was built in 1916-17 for lumberman Nels Michelson and later became the home of Motown Records founder Berry Gordy Jr. Historic Detroit identifies the property as the Nels Michelson Mansion and documents its origins, architecture and notable owners. Gordy bought the house in 1967 and lived there during a pivotal period for Motown before eventually selling it to Detroit attorney Cynthia F. description: A historic Nantucket home built around 1834 for sea captain George C. Gardner is now for sale. This Greek Revival residence has undergone significant moves and two major restoration efforts. The 7,000-plus-square-foot house combines 19th-century character with modern amenities. It features a swimming pool and a separate three-bedroom guest cottage on the property. The property is situated on Nantucket’s Main Street, close to local attractions.
title: 1834 Nantucket home sold for $9.5m, now listed for $32 million

author: ARGHYA PRASUN ROYCHOWDHURY
description: India's latest health survey shows below-normal BMI is not decreasing while overweight and obesity are rising. Women's normal BMI range fell significantly, and men's share also shrank considerably. Below-normal BMI increased in many states, and overweight or obesity rose even more widely. Urban areas show higher rates of both underweight and overweight conditions for men and women.
title: India sees rise in both overweight and underweight

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: In Mumbai's spot market on Monday, gold was trading at Rs 1.57 lakh per 10 grams, including 3% goods and services tax. This was around 60% higher than the Rs 98,000 per 10 grams recorded on Ganesh Chaturthi last year, which fell on August 28.
title: Gold jumps 60% to Rs 1.57L from Rs 98,000 a year ago; sales fall 15%, coins gain

author: RAJEEV SINGH
description: Much of what worries Western officials is not a tank invasion but something harder to pin down. Drones drifting into Baltic airspace, sabotage at airports, cyberattacks, plots involving criminal networks operating far from Russia's own territory. Individually, each incident can be denied or dismissed as an accident but likely form a pattern that lets Moscow probe Nato's resolve without technically starting a war.
title: Russia planning 'grey zone operations'? Why is Europe intuitively spooked

author: HIJAM RAJU SINGH
description: India secured their first gold medal at the Asian Games 2026. Harmanpreet Kaur's team defeated Sri Lanka in the women's cricket final. Smriti Mandhana and Shafali Verma provided a strong opening partnership. Richa Ghosh's quick cameo propelled India to a formidable total. This victory marked India's seventh medal overall in the competition.
title: First gold for India at Asian Games 2026: Women's cricket team beats Sri Lanka in final

author: SHEEZAN NEZAMI
description: Allegations of a headmaster's inappropriate actions have surfaced at a Nawada government school.  These incidents follow a Class X student's alleged molestation in Jamui.  Girls reported the headmaster entered their washroom and touched them inappropriately.  The headmaster was arrested under the POCSO Act after protests by students and parents.  These events highlight serious concerns regarding the safety of minor girls in Bihar.
title: ‘Made us sit on lap’: Bihar girls accuse headmaster of entering washroom, harassing

author: SHREEDHAR RATHI
description: A 34-year-old man was arrested after residents caught him assaulting a six-year-old girl.  The accused was apprehended by locals and handed over to the police.  The child received immediate medical examination, and evidence was collected at the scene.  An FIR was registered under the POCSO Act and Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita.  The incident occurred amid other recent alleged sexual offenses against minors in Delhi.
title: Enraged Delhi locals thrash man after catching him sexually assaulting 6-year-old

author: AKSHAY BHAGWAT
description: Darshan Solanki's father was detained by Powai police on Monday. He was protesting caste discrimination on the IIT-B campus. The father sought a meeting with the IIT-B director to discuss suicide prevention steps. Protesters were denied entry, and one alleged police manhandling. This incident follows three student suicides at the institute this year.
title: Father of dalit IIT-Bombay student, who died by suicide in 2023, detained at stir

author: TOI Astrology
description: Repeating numbers such as 11:11 are often perceived as spiritual messages from the universe. They encourage individuals to take a moment to stop and contemplate their life paths. Each numeral imparts a unique significance, ranging from fresh starts to endings and personal evolution. While these numerical symbols provide insights, the onus of decision-making lies with the individual. Numerology enriches daily experiences, offering solace and direction that complement proactive choices.
title: Meaning of repeating numbers: Angel signs and numerology explained

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: The court has quashed the prosecution, which arose from an allegation that the man had sold a 600-ml bottle of cold drink for Rs 26 even though its MRP was Rs 25. The allegation concerned an overcharge of Re 1. The man was working at his wife's shop when the incident took place.
title: Wife sold Rs 25 soft drink for Rs 26; husband faced case for 13 years, HC quashes it

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: Physicists at CERN's Large Hadron Collider have found strong evidence for quantum entanglement.  Two short-lived Z bosons, produced from a Higgs boson decay, showed quantum correlations.  This observation confirms quantum mechanics' strange predictions in extreme energy environments.  Researchers reconstructed Z boson properties from their decay products for analysis.  Future experiments will further investigate quantum phenomena at even higher energies.
title: Einstein’s ‘spooky action’ survives extreme CERN test with Z bosons

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: In 1910, Oregon introduced European beachgrass to stabilise shifting dunes near Coos Bay. The plant succeeded but spread widely, covering much of the dune system and changing sand movement. As open, shifting habitats declined, native plants and animals adapted to moving dunes, including the endangered Western Snowy Plover, also lost important habitat.
title: Oregon planted European beachgrass in 1910; it later reshaped the coast

author: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK
description: Nestled within California's scenic Suisun Marsh, a remarkable 400-acre private island retreat is up for sale at $1.5 million. This historic Concord Farms Duck Club features an expansive clubhouse and nine exclusive hunting blinds, steeped in a century of hunting legacy. Ideal for nature enthusiasts, this secluded property offers a unique wildlife sanctuary, catering to those looking for a tranquil escape outside the conventional hunting experience.
title: California hunting club lists 400-acre private island for $1.5 million

author: PRATYUSH RAJ AND SAHIL MALHOTRA
description: During the recently concluded season of the Delhi Premier League, cricketer Vansh Bedi from Central Delhi Kings reported an attempt at match-fixing to the Anti-Corruption Wing. The Delhi and District Cricket Association is now looking to the BCCI for guidance following this incident linked to a sting operation conducted by a media outlet.
title: Vansh Bedi reported fixing approach during DPL; DDCA seeks BCCI intervention

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: For the Mahanadi Basin discovery, ONGC's next phase of work will involve additional reservoir appraisal, evaluation of recoverable resources and a commercial assessment. A decision on development will be taken only after these steps are completed.
title: Major milestone for energy exploration: ONGC strikes gas 43 km off Odisha coast

author: SAURABH THAKUR
description: The Supreme Court will not decide on the National Song's stanza length now.  It will examine if not singing it can be a punishable offense.  The court referenced a past ruling stating no one can be punished for not singing the National Anthem.  The Centre opposed the challenge, citing a "naxalite mindset" for questioning the song.  The court asked the Centre to file its response to the public interest litigation.
title: Is not singing Vande Mataram punishable offence? Supreme Court to examine

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Zoho founder Sridhar Vembu cautions engineers about excessive AI use in software creation. He advises using AI tools without losing essential understanding of the development process. An engineer described AI generating nearly all software components, causing team dissatisfaction. This rapid adoption of AI tools outpaces industry comprehension, inviting potential disaster. Engineers are working long hours directing AI, leading to a soul-sucking experience.
title: Zoho founder Sridhar Vembu to engineers: Use AI but never cede

author: TNN
description: In a police operation targeting Nandan Yadav, the accused in a Jamui molestation case, he sustained a bullet injury to his leg and is now receiving medical treatment. This follow-up comes after viral videos of the incident sparked outrage across social media. Authorities have identified and charged several individuals related to the case, with investigations ongoing and steps being taken to erase the circulated videos.
title: Bihar molestation case: Main accused Nandan Yadav injured in police encounter

author: SUHAS BIRHADE
description: Asgar Ali Vora struggles to regain his land after a developer relinquished possession.  He had purchased the property in 1989 and alleged developers took possession in 2011.  After meeting Prime Minister Narendra Modi, one developer relinquished the land.  However, another developer allegedly continues to retain possession of the property.  Police have registered a non-cognisable offence against the involved developers.
title: PM classmate’s battle for land continues despite BJP MLA's exit

author: ABHINAV GARG
description: A Delhi High Court case explores returning an adopted orphan child years later.  The adoptive mother seeks to hand over custody due to behavioral issues.  The child was adopted in 2018 and later discovered to have intellectual disability.  He exhibits aggression and theft, leading to school expulsions.  The court seeks the stance of authorities on housing the minor.
title: Can orphan adopted legally be 'returned' years later?

author: AJAY TOMAR
description: Tragedy struck at RIMS Hospital in Adilabad when a five-day-old newborn sadly lost their life due to a fire that broke out late Monday night. Fortunately, twenty-eight children were safely evacuated from the affected ward. The flames ignited around 11:50 pm, leading to a swift response from fire services. Firefighters managed to control the situation, while police have since registered a case and are investigating the circumstances surrounding the incident.
title: 5-day-old infant dies after fire breaks out at Telangana's RIMS hospital; 28 newborns rescued

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: A digital creator recently showcased the varying designs of toddler shorts, intended for kids aged eighteen months. The differences in cut sparked discussions among parents, who are prioritizing comfort and practicality rather than adhering to traditional gender stereotypes. They are selecting clothing from diverse sections to ensure a better fit and greater freedom for their active toddlers, highlighting the shift towards functionality over labels.
title: Why are girls’ shorts shorter than boys’ at 18 months? Moms raise questions

author: LAIRENLAKPAM WARLI
description: A 91-year-old woman named Najamunisa Begum died on Monday in Koppal district. She was allegedly attacked and pushed by a monkey while standing outside her home. The injured woman was immediately rushed to a hospital for urgent medical treatment. Sadly, she later succumbed to her severe injuries sustained during the incident. Authorities are currently investigating the precise circumstances surrounding this unfortunate monkey attack.
title: 91-year-old woman dies after monkey attacks, pushes her in Karnataka

author: etimes.in
description: A traditional practice suggests that pressing a baby's nose each day can help shape it more sharply over time. Nevertheless, doctors assert that this method does not effectively change the nose's structure. Unlike the skull, the cartilage in a nose remains pliable and does not possess internal rigidity. For a lasting change in nose shape, surgical procedures are necessary.
title: Can you reshape a newborn’s nose with your fingers? Doctor debunks viral claim

author: SAURABH THAKUR
description: A consumer commission ordered MakeMyTrip to refund Rs 18,775 for non-existent hotels. The complainant booked two properties which were not found at their listed locations. This led to the family sleeping in their car in sub-zero temperatures. MakeMyTrip was held liable for listing misrepresented and non-existent properties. The commission also awarded compensation and litigation costs to the aggrieved consumer.
title: MakeMyTrip ordered to pay Rs 48,775 after two booked hotels found non-existent

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: In Uttar Pradesh, women don green saris and wield lathis, forming the Green Army to tackle pressing village issues like gambling, alcohol misuse, and domestic violence. Drawing strength from their personal experiences, they advocate for girls' education and fight against child marriages. Their initiatives also include celebrating daughters' births and supporting sustainable livelihoods, fostering significant social transformation in rural areas.
title: Meet UP’s Green Army: Women fighting violence, addiction and child marriage

author: ADVITYA BAHL
description: A 40-year-old man died and his wife was injured after a Thar SUV collided with their scooter. The accident occurred in the Bisrakh police station area on Monday. Neeraj succumbed to his injuries during treatment at a hospital. Police have taken the Thar SUV into custody and are searching for the driver. Legal proceedings are underway after obtaining a complaint from the victim's family.
title: 40-year-old man dies after Thar hits scooter in Greater Noida, wife injured

author: TNN
description: The TOI-DPA Airline Price Index monitors daily fluctuations in domestic airfares across India, illuminating trends in inflation, demand, and pricing strategies for various routes. Additionally, the Fare Timing Index reveals how ticket prices adjust over time related to booking. Factors such as departure times and specific days of the week play a critical role in determining fare costs, leading to valuable insights into airline pricing dynamics.
title: TOI-DPA Airfare Index: A flight price tracker that will help you plan trips better

title: Plano teen built AI air-quality model now used across 60 schools

description: Jacob Arabo's journey into the world of horology began in Tashkent when his father gifted him a watch. He transitioned from school to supporting his family at seventeen, consolidating his talent for jewelry design. Known as 'Jacob the Jeweler', he captured the spotlight with his iconic Five Time Zone watch in 2002. Jacob & Co.
title: Jacob Arabo got a watch at 13; years later, his creations reached A-list wrists

author: DHRUV YADAV
description: Network-centric warfare is reshaping how wars are fought and won today. India faces significant security challenges across multiple domains simultaneously. Existing Indian defense networks like AFNET and DCN are crucial for integration. These systems enable faster battlefield decisions and shared operational pictures. Companies are actively developing capabilities for this evolving warfare.
title: From Op Sindoor to Urgent Fury, how network warfare has changed the way conflicts are fought

description: A 17-year-old girl was allegedly gang-raped by three men posing as police officers. The incident occurred in a park near Kalkaji Mandir after the girl and her friend visited the temple. Police received a PCR call and reached the spot, taking the girl for medical examination. Authorities are scanning CCTV footage and gathering information to identify the accused.

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Cristiano Ronaldo and Georgina Rodríguez bought a €25 million plot on Dubai’s Jumeirah Bay Island in 2024 and planned a custom family mansion there. The move followed their decision to rent out their Madrid home for €10,000 a month. The Dubai property gives the family a major base closer to Ronaldo’s life with Al-Nassr in Saudi Arabia.

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Vedaant Madhavan debuted at the Asian Games in the freestyle relay event.  The Indian team did not qualify for the final round.  Vedaant shared his disappointment on social media after the race.  His father, R Madhavan, expressed his support and pride.  Madhavan previously spoke about his son's dedicated swimming routine.
title: R Madhavan REACTS to son Vedaant's Asian Games performance

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Every exam season, the same scene repeats itself in homes across India. Lights stay on past midnight, notebooks pile up, and a student who has barely looked at a chapter all year suddenly spends twelve hours a day buried in it. And yet, when results come in, the outcome is often disappointing. Not because the child didn't work hard enough, but because working harder under panic and working smart under calm are two completely different things and we keep confusing one for the other.
title: Why do students study more under pressure but remember less?

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Taylor Swift will be the first recipient of the MTV Video Music Awards artist-director honors at this year's awards ceremony, a newly created award recognizing musicians whose work behind the camera has contributed to music video production and
title: Taylor Swift wins MTV's new artist director award

author: TNN
description: A 35-year-old police constable died by suicide late Sunday evening.  He was attached to the Armed Reserve of Malkajgiri commissionerate.  The constable reportedly called his fiancée before taking the extreme step.  Police are probing the exact cause of his death.  He was under distress after learning his marriage might not happen.
title: Marriage plans in doubt, Hyderabad cop ends life after video call with fiancee

description: External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar called for stronger multilateralism at a UNGA summit. He stressed greater international cooperation to address conflicts and emerging technologies. India also co-chaired the first Partners for Multilateralism summit in New York. Slovakia backed India's bid for a permanent UN Security Council seat. The Visegrad Group plus India meeting marked a new historic occasion.

author: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK
description: Puducherry is extending its generous initiative that provides free house plots to economically disadvantaged families and those belonging to scheduled caste communities. Since its inception in 1981, the scheme supports individuals who do not have land for housing. Eligible applicants must be Indian citizens with a yearly family income below Rs 24,000 and need to present a range of documents including identity, residence, income, and caste certificates.
title: How Puducherry offers housing sites to homeless and underprivileged communities

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Amazon has decided to prevent Meta's Muse AI from making any purchases on its platform, citing important privacy and security issues. While Meta insists its AI manages user credentials safely, this conflict underscores the tension between these tech giants. The situation also emphasizes the intensifying competition for shopper engagement in the realm of digital commerce.

description: On September 20, Surendra Singh Choudhary, affectionately called Bittu Tabahi, spearheaded a remarkable cleanup initiative along the banks of the Yamuna river. In a dedicated four-hour effort, he and a team of volunteers successfully gathered an impressive 585 kilograms of litter. This endeavor was part of World Cleanup Day, supported by Philip Morris.

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Meet Roger Cettina, 59, a Hall of Fame horseplayer who began with $2 teenage bets before winning nearly $500,000 in National Horseplayers Championship contests. After decades of loving Belmont Park as a fan, Cettina got the chance to help rebuild the legendary racetrack. He calls the experience an unbelievable, once-in-a-lifetime opportunity.
title: Horse racing fan turns $2 bets into $500K, helps rebuild Belmont Park

author: JYOTIRMOY HALDER
description: India suffered a narrow 2.5-1.5 defeat to hosts Uzbekistan in Round 6 of the Chess Olympiad after Nihal Sarin let a winning position slip, allowing Nodirbek Yakubboev to capture his queen for free. With Praggnanandhaa, Arjun Erigaisi and D Gukesh drawing, Nihal’s loss proved decisive. India’s women bounced back against the United States, winning 3-1 after their previous-round defeat to Poland.
title: Chess Olympiad Round 6: How Nihal Sarin blundered his queen in India’s loss

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman addressed concerns over the Merchant Discount Rate charges, emphasizing that UPI users will face no additional financial burden. These charges apply solely to payment operators and do not treat consumers as taxpayers. The revised rule targets only high-value Person-to-Merchant UPI transactions, meaning most users will transact without incurring extra fees. The government has expressed its commitment to this decision, ruling out any changes.
title: 'No burden for consumers': Sitharaman clarifies who will pay MDR on UPI transactions

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Meet Joe Petraro-Hyppolite, a 13-year-old Long Island prodigy with a reported IQ of 168, who has been accepted into an NYU master’s programme. He scored 1590 on the SAT at 10 and graduated high school at 11. After battling leukemia and Tourette syndrome, he continues his remarkable academic journey while pursuing sports management and biology.
title: 13-year-old genius with 'Einstein IQ' to start NYU master's

Yemen's Houthis conducted attacks on Riyadh and a Saudi Aramco facility. Traffic through the Strait of Hormuz has dropped sharply due to ongoing conflict. The US and Iran have traded threats for over six months now.

description: US Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said the communications lines had been repaired and operations were gradually resuming, although passengers were still expected to face delays as airlines worked through the backlog. "The telecom lines have been repaired, and all airport operations in the Northeast are resuming," Duffy said. The outage meant that flights headed for some of the airports could not land.
title: US airports resume operations after telecom outage disrupts thousands of flights

description: MrBeast has defended his $10 million Ghana village project aimed at combating child labour after being questioned over spending overseas. The YouTuber said he “literally” supports his hometown of Greenville, North Carolina, highlighting his local philanthropy. The project includes homes, a school, clean water infrastructure, farms and other facilities for local communities.
title: MrBeast defends $10M Ghana village project after backlash

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: A Stanford Medicine study has challenged the traditional understanding of brain development, finding that the forebrain and hindbrain arise from separate progenitor cells. Researchers traced this two-system pattern across 550 million years of evolution, including in chickens, zebrafish and acorn worms. The discovery could help scientists study brainstem diseases and develop better laboratory models.
title: Human brain evolved from 2 ancient nervous systems: Stanford study

description: The legendary mansion of Muhammad Ali in Los Angeles has been sold for a remarkable $8.5 million. Designed in the elegant Italian Renaissance style, this exquisite property was built in 1915 and boasts original architectural details. With nine bedrooms and seven bathrooms, this iconic home in Fremont Place embarks on a fresh journey for its new owners.
title: Muhammad Ali's 1915 LA mansion with Tiffany glass sells for $8.5M

author: YOGITA RAO AND HEMALI CHHAPIA
description: Following the unfortunate death of a student, IIT-Bombay has placed its administrative dean on leave pending an investigation. The institution has retracted its previous statement about the circumstances surrounding the student's examination. Students are actively protesting for more decisive actions and the formation of an independent inquiry committee. The grieving family accuses the institute of abetment and harassment, seeking a CID-led investigation, as campus tensions mount.

author: SAMAD HOQUE
description: A sham Apple service centre in Palam Vihar was busted by Gurgaon police.  Elderly US citizens were targeted with fake privacy and virus warnings.  Impersonators then demanded thousands of dollars using bogus Federal Trade Commission notices.  Police have traced transactions worth two crore rupees from fifteen victims.  Eleven individuals were arrested, and the main operator remains at large.
title: Fake Apple centre in Gurgaon ‘shortlisted’ elderly in US, scared them into paying up to $20k
